description:
Jailbreak iOS or iPadOS 17.6.1 with Dopamine 3 on supported A12, A12X, A12Z and A13 devices. This walkthrough uses a real iPad result and covers the official download, IPA installation, Developer Mode, the jailbreak process, Sileo, ElleKit, PreferenceLoader, reboot behavior and troubleshooting.

IMPORTANT: This does not support every A12-or-newer device on 17.6.1. A14–A17 and M1–M2 devices are officially listed only through iOS/iPadOS 17.3.1 on real devices.

Full written guide: https://nextjailbreak.com/dopamine-3-jailbreak-ios-17-6-1.html
Official Dopamine page: https://ellekit.space/dopamine/
Official releases: https://github.com/opa334/Dopamine/releases
Official installation guide: https://ios.cfw.guide/installing-dopamine/
